title: ActionPlan
description: The SIGNED plan executed by the Action Executor (GROWTH-OS-BUILD-SPEC §7.4, §10.2, P4/P5). The ONLY object a connector will mutate from — connectors verify status=signed + a valid signature before ANY platform mutation (P4: money is sacred; no side door). Carries the §P5 Explanation (no silent actions), lives in the hash-chained Action Ledger, and is executed via the Temporal LaunchSaga with compensation (§10.2). Frozen-after-merge; new fields ⇒ version bump.

version.description: Schema version of the ActionPlan shape (frozen-after-merge).

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant. Set from the actor's token context, never from a request body (the isolation rule, P6).

correlation_id.description: Journey id this plan belongs to (§6.3), so the ledger is queryable by journey (GET /actions?journey=).

causation_id.description: The event/decision that caused this plan (e.g. an optimization.decision event_id).

actor.description: Who proposed the plan (P5: agent | user | system | webhook).

action_type.description: The class of action (drives policy gate + approval thresholds). Aligns with explanation.action.type and optimization.decision vocab.

target_ref.description: The primary platform entity this plan acts on (e.g. 'meta:ad:123', 'meta:adset:456', or a media_plan_id for a launch). §7.4 target_ref.

operations.description: The ordered, typed connector operations the Executor performs (LaunchSaga steps, §10.2). Each is idempotent (P3) and reversible-or-compensated. Connectors accept these ONLY inside a signed plan (P4).

op_id.description: Plan-local stable id for ordering + compensation pairing.

op.description: The connector verb (e.g. create_campaign, update_budget, pause_entity, create_ad, dispatch_capi).

params.description: Op parameters (validated by the connector's own contract). Spend-changing amounts in INR paise (integer).

idempotency_key.description: Exactly-once key for this external mutation (P3). Stable across retries.

compensation.description: The inverse op to run if a later step fails (LaunchSaga rollback, §10.2: never leave half-live spend).

budget_impact.description: The money delta this plan introduces. P4: any spend-changing plan needs a Budget Governor stamp to be signed (§13.1). All amounts INR paise (integer).

daily_delta_minor.description: Net change to daily spend, INR paise (integer; may be negative).

governor_stamp.description: The Budget Governor stamp proving sum(daily budgets) ≤ daily_cap holds (§13.1/§13.2). REQUIRED before a spend-changing plan can be signed.

explanation.description: The mandatory §P5 Explanation emitted BEFORE execution (no silent actions).

status.description: Ledger lifecycle (§7.4). Connectors mutate ONLY when status=signed (P4).

approval.description: Approval state when the policy gate (§17) requires a human. Temporal signal on response; auto-escalate on timeout (§17.2).

expires_at.description: When the approval window expires (auto-escalation deadline).

step_up.description: Firewall step-up proof for sensitive intents (PIN/OTP + HS256 token, sub-bound, TTL, §17.3). Required for money/destructive actions initiated via AI Manager.

signatures.description: Detached signatures over the plan's canonical bytes (§7.4 signatures[]). Connectors verify at least one valid signature whose signer is authorized to sign this action_type before mutating (P4).

signer.description: Key id / signer identity (e.g. ledger service key id).

signature.description: Base64/hex signature over the canonical plan payload (everything except signatures + ledger hash fields).

ledger.description: Hash-chain linkage written by the Action Ledger (§7.4, §5.5 tamper-evident).

expires_at.description: When an unsigned/unapproved plan goes stale and must not execute.
